notes.title: Watch the Stream
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We have just announced our game "[b]The Dream Office[/b]" and we have already a demo for you to play (for free of course)! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44365314/237fbdcade15b4427fa64245fe7e9cdd8e3d47cf.jpg[/img]
